Game Overview

River Crosser is a hyper-casual title where guide a daring frog across a treacherous river by tapping to jump forward, but beware of the watery depths. With only three lives, test your timing and nerves in this endless challenge that intensifies as you progress. Can you earn the highest score? Ideal for quick, engaging play.

River Crosser keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide a daring frog across a treacherous river by tapping to jump forward, but beware of the watery depths!
